probes: 9 NEW prompts, none from H1-H3, plus capital of Canada factual
measures: Hostility and coherence rated INDEPENDENTLY by manual reading: hostility = hostile/partial/benign, coherence = coherent/looping/nonsense/off-topic. Unique-word ratio and perplexity are proxies only, never conflated with either rating.
patching: Prompt-token L17 N9209 activation replaced with baseline-run values. Generated tokens not patched, stated limitation.
activation_measurement: L17 N9209 prompt mean under baseline, L14, pair, per prompt, recorded in results.
revision_pinning: Transformers/torch versions and HF model revision recorded in results.versions/model_revision.

software_pins.note: latest PyPI stable on 2026-10-26; H1-H3 used unpinned -U installs, which would have resolved to these or earlier
